pull.title: Introduce CoW when adding Active Record reflections
pull.body:
### Motivation / Background

This Pull Request has been created because we can't run `Post.find` , `Post.where`  etc.. inside a Ractor due to the reflection cache that's not frozen.

### Detail

We need to make Reflection ractor safe and freeze the cache that holds those reflections.
This patch deep freeze the reflection and the aggregated reflection one.

The fixes are somewhat similar to other Ractor safety problems we encountered and we need to eager load otherwise lazily memoized values before freezing (there is a lot of them).

There is one memoization that moved from one method to another, and I explained in details why in the commit message.

### Checklist

Before submitting the PR make sure the following are checked:

* [x] This Pull Request is related to one change. Unrelated changes should be opened in separate PRs.
* [x] Commit message has a detailed description of what changed and why. If this PR fixes a related issue include it in the commit message. Ex: `[Fix #issue-number]`
* [x] Tests are added or updated if you fix a bug or add a feature.
* [ ] CHANGELOG files are updated for the changed libraries if there is a behavior change or additional feature. Minor bug fixes and documentation changes should not be included.

cc/ @gmcgibbon @skipkayhil @etiennebarrie

commit.message:
Introduce CoW when adding Active Record reflections:

- ### Problem

  Attempting to run a `where` query (or any other queries that reaches
  for the reflection) will raise inside a Ractor.
  We need to make Reflection ractor safe and freeze the cache that
  holds those reflections.

  This patch deep freeze the reflection and the aggregated reflection
  one.

  ### Solution

  The fixes are somewhat similar to other Ractor safety problems we
  encountered and we need to eager load otherwise lazily memoized
  values before freezing (there is a lot of them).

  ----

  One change worth flagging and explaining:

  On the `MacroReflection` class, there used to be a memoization
  inside the `def klass` method. This memoization has now moved inside
  the `def _klass` one.
  The reason for this change is because of a ThroughReflection, and
  freezing it reaches code that were never called before and aren't
  meant to be called.

  ```ruby
  has_many :posts_tagging, through: :some_model
  ```

  When an association is declared like this, Rails creates
  a ThroughReflection that wraps around a HasManyReflection
  instance, and bunch of methods are delegated to it.

  Before, Active Record would never reach into the
  `HasManyReflection#klass` method, simply because it would try
  to derive the class name `PostTagging` which is not a thing. The
  real class name is `SomeModel`. That's why the ThroughReflection,
  implements `def klass` and call `#_klass` with the right model
  name.

  With this patch, when we call `Ractor.make_shareable` on the
  ThroughReflection, *any* reachable objects are now frozen,
  and since we need to eagerload `klass`, then the underlying
  HasManyReflection#klass gets called too and end up raising
  an error "Undefined class PostsTagging".

  By moving the memoization, once Ruby freeze the ThroughReflection
  and move on to attempt freezing its reachable HasManyReflection,
  the `@klass` would already have been set.

         if polymorphic?

         end
       end
 
+      test "ractorize! makes model reflections Ractor-shareable" do
+        app_file "app/models/post.rb", <<~RUBY
+          class Post < ActiveRecord::Base
+            has_one :comment
+          end
+        RUBY
+        app_file "app/models/comment.rb", <<~RUBY
+          class Comment < ActiveRecord::Base
+            belongs_to :post
+          end
+        RUBY
+        app_file "config/initializers/active_record.rb", <<~RUBY
+          ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(adapter: "sqlite3", database: ":memory:")
+          ActiveRecord::Migration.verbose = false
+          ActiveRecord::Schema.define(version: 1) do
+            create_table :posts
+            create_table :comments do |t|
+              t.belongs_to :post
+            end
+          end
+          ActiveRecord::Base.schema_cache.add("posts")
+          ActiveRecord::Base.schema_cache.add("comments")
+        RUBY
+
+        app "production"
+
+        ractorize!
+
+        assert Ractor.shareable?(Post._reflections)
+        assert_equal "Comment", on_ractor { Post.reflect_on_association(:comment).klass.name }
+      end
+
       private
         def ractorize!
           @original_experimental_warning = Warning[:experimental]
